plugins.name: arcade
plugins.description: A tiny catch-and-dodge game in the band above the prompt while Claude works. Every tool call drops something into it

plugins.name: cli-tools
plugins.description: Turn shell commands into typed tools the model sees from the first turn

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: A live pane for what surrounds the session: cost, context, git, PR checks, your own gauges, an inbox for messages from other sessions, and an away-mode summary

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Claude proposes a new mod; nothing is written until you approve it in a dialog. Also suggests a mod when the same tool-call sequence repeats

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Boundaries, secret masking, a second opinion before irreversible commands, shell autocorrect, loop breaker, diff budget

plugins.name: ledger
plugins.description: Active hours per repo with a /hours pane, CSV export and a monthly goal line; drafts a build-in-public post when you merge a PR

plugins.name: pet
plugins.description: A small creature per repo in the band above the prompt. Passing tests, commits and merged PRs feed it; failing tests, force pushes and red CI make it sick

plugins.name: recall
plugins.description: Context you would otherwise retype: memory recall per prompt, smarter @-mentions, repeated-correction rules, a friction log and selection verbs

plugins.name: replay
plugins.description: Scrub through a session's file changes turn by turn, each drawn as a unified diff

plugins.name: rival
plugins.description: A quiet second reviewer: after a turn that changed files, a read-only subagent looks for correctness bugs in the diff and reports in a band above the prompt

plugins.name: thrift
plugins.description: Spend less on tokens and money: a model router, a context coach, a context forecast and an instruction diet

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Plain replies backed by evidence: strips filler and AI tells from the model's text, and flags factual claims that cite no file:line, command output or URL
